text_block_list.text:
At last, Грасс Вандер is set to make her
debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In contrast to the anxiety I feel, she
appears
completely undisturbed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She heads for the track, ready to do
business as
usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
